_comment: What the snapshots page reads at build time. The page has one tab per group. The bucket cannot be listed publicly, so the candidate heights are listed here; a height whose manifest is not published yet is simply not shown, and a family with "hide_until_published" shows no card until its first manifest is published. A manifest is used only where its format, network, height, storage mode (kogany) and flavour (ycashd) match the family. Layout and fields: ycash-infra bundles/state/FORMAT.md (ycash-state/2; ycash-state/3, the same stream stored in parts that the manifest names; kogany-state/1 and /2) and bundles/state/mainnet/README.md; the full-insight layout (main-insight/) is ycash-infra PR 44. A hidden family with "coming" shows that one muted line in its tab instead, until its manifest is published.

groups.heading: Kogany snapshots
groups.lead: Kogany's state database, for koganyd only.
notes: State format 30.2.0 (koganyd beta1 and beta2). koganyd beta3 restores it and upgrades it to 30.3.0 once at the first start; a build with another format ignores it and syncs from genesis.

groups.heading: Ycash6 snapshots
notes: No wallet, peers.dat or ycash.conf. -reindex-chainstate rechecks the state from the snapshot's own blocks.

families.title: Pruned
families.contains: Headers, UTXO set, nullifiers, note commitment trees, vault and YED state
families.desc: All the state a node needs, with raw transactions for the last 34,560 blocks (30 days).
families.note: One-way: the node must run in pruned mode (tx_retention ≥ 10,000) and can't go back to archive. Step 2 sets it.

families.title: Archive
families.desc: The full state, with every raw transaction since genesis.
families.note: Restores into an archive or a pruned node.

families.title: Full datadir
families.contains: blocks/ with undo files, the block index, chainstate/, vaults/, the node's state statement and Sapling tree state
families.desc: Every block, the chainstate and vaults, for a node on default flags.
families.note: No txindex or insight explorer indexes.

families.title: Full insight
families.contains: The full datadir, plus blocks/index/ (txindex) and blocks/insight-index/
families.desc: The full datadir plus txindex and the insight explorer indexes, already built.
families.note: Needs experimentalfeatures=1, insightexplorer=1 and txindex=1, or the node refuses to start. Step 5 adds them.
families.more: The checksum covers the indexes; no statement field does: they are the publisher's, not consensus state.
families.coming: Full insight snapshot (txindex + address indexes): coming
